biomarkers.name: DUSP22 rearrangement
biomarkers.clinical_use: Prognostic biomarker associated with relatively favourable outcome versus other ALK-negative ALCLs, though not consistently equivalent to ALK+ ALCL across studies

biomarkers.name: CD30
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic hallmark; supports use of brentuximab vedotin + CHP first-line in CD30-positive PTCL including systemic ALCL (ECHELON-2)

biomarkers.name: Breast implant-associated ALCL (BIA-ALCL) — distinct entity
biomarkers.clinical_use: Peri-implant seroma/effusion and/or capsule presentation; usually localised; complete surgical excision with en bloc capsulectomy is curative in most localized cases

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Similar to ALK+ ALCL — large pleomorphic 'hallmark' cells with horseshoe- or kidney-shaped nuclei; CD30+ but ALK-
variants: breast implant-associated ALCL (BIA-ALCL — distinct entity, often localised)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Strong CD30 expression supports brentuximab vedotin activity (ECHELON-2)
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Cohesive tumour cell clusters can be seen; BIA-ALCL is often confined to the peri-implant capsule/effusion

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Mature post-thymic T cells (without ALK rearrangement/activation) with distinct molecular subtypes
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Similar hallmark cell morphology to ALK+ ALCL but ALK-negative; CD30+ is a defining feature; T-cell markers are often variably expressed
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Molecular subtypes reflect distinct biology: DUSP22-rearranged (~20–30%, relatively favourable prognosis), TP63-rearranged (~8%, very aggressive with poor prognosis); BIA-ALCL is a distinct localised entity arising in association with breast implants, especially textured implants
